info.title: What banks in the Vault
info.levelUpBody: Every level you reach banks a bonus — and the higher the tier, the bigger the drop.
info.capBody: Streak multipliers past an activity's daily cap bank here instead of being lost.
info.vestBody: Deposits vest for {{days}} days, then unlock into your spendable balance. They count towards your level straight away.
info.gateBody: POWR banks and vests as normal below Level {{level}}, and counts toward your level the whole time — it just can't be taken out until you get there. Nothing expires.
info.graceBody_one: Unlock it yourself for the moment — or leave it. Anything still sitting there {{count}} day after it matures moves into your balance automatically.
